segments.text: Reiji is a private investigator who specializes in solving grisly murder cases. He used to be a police detective, but after the tragic death of his fiancée, he left the force. Now, he runs a detective agency in Shinjuku, taking on some of the city's most brutal crimes.

Reiji lives with his younger sister, Yukari, in Suginami, though he's rarely home because he's so focused on his work. Despite his tough exterior, Reiji is a bit of a history buff. When he's not on the job, he loves diving into history books, a passion he likely inherited from his late parents, who were both scholars. Their home is filled with a massive collection of historical books and documents.

In the first episode, Reiji goes undercover as a history teacher at Ouba Girls Academy to investigate a series of mysterious student disappearances, following a request from the school's vice-principal.
Occupation: Private Detective
Hobbies: Reading (mainly history books)
”It’s easy to understand why these criminals do what they do if you give it a little thought.”
Translated and edited from the official site
職業：私立探偵
趣味：読書（主に歴史書）
本作の主人公で、主に凶悪犯罪の調査を請け負う探偵。
元は刑事だったが、とある事件で恋人を失い、辞職した。
現在は、妹の紫と二人暮らしだが、仕事を優先しているため、
自宅にはあまり帰っていない様子。
仕事のない時には歴史書を読み漁る世界史マニアで、
今回の依頼も、世界史の特別講師として女学院に潜入した。
本作的主人公，曾任警察。在某事件中失去了恋人，辞去工作。
现在在新宿经营侦探事务所，主要接受对杀人事件等凶恶犯罪的调查。
家住杉并区，和妹妹紫一起生活，由于工作优先而不怎么回家。
由于那生来的学者气质，在不工作的时候就是搜寻历史书的世界史狂热者。由于已故的双亲曾是学者，家中书库里有大量的藏书。
应樱羽女学院的教导主任所托，作为世界史特别讲师而潜入学院，调查女学生下落不明的事件。
Occupation: Student at Ouba Girls Academy (a member of the art club)
Hobbies: Entomology; raising and keeping bugs
An old-fashioned, reliable type of girl. She takes care of her older brother, who is helpless with household chores. Yukari stops by Reiji’s office periodically to help him clean it up.

She is also an academic like her brother, but with interests rooted in entomology. She keeps various insects inside her room. Don’t let your guard down around her, as some of her insect friends may turn up on the dinner table when you least expect them.
”All I want to do is be there for you, Nii-san.”
Edited from MangaGamer
Yukari believes it would be difficult to make a living through art, and, unable to picture a clear future for herself, she is also troubled over what path to take.
Her relationship with Masaki remains much the same even after they’ve grown older: never too close, never too distant, the two continue to hover somewhere in between.
(Though Yukari, at least, has started to become somewhat more conscious of him.)
職業：櫻羽女学院生（美術部所属）
趣味：虫の観察・飼育
家事ができない兄を支える、古式ゆかしい大和撫子タイプの、できた妹。
探偵事務所も定期的に掃除しており、玲人は色々な面で紫に頭があがらない。
兄と同じく学者肌の面を持ち、虫関係の知識はかなり深い。
自室で様々な虫を飼育しているが、虫が逃げ出したり、
何気なく、虫料理を食卓に並べるため、油断できない。
比玲人小很多的妹妹。由于哥哥对家务一窍不通，自然而然地精通家务了。
当面和背后都支持着哥哥，性格坚强，古老典雅的大和抚子类型。
玲人的侦探事务所由紫定期进行打扫，玲人各方面上在紫面前抬不起头。
和哥哥一样拥有学者气质，其才能主要发挥在与虫有关的方面上，对于虫的方面有着相当丰富的知识。
此外，在自己房间里饲养着各种虫，有时虫会偷跑出来。她有时会若无其事地端出虫料理，在这方面让人丝毫不能大意。
「我只要能成为哥哥的依靠那就足够了。只要这样就行了——」
Occupation: Student at Ouba Girls Academy (a member of the art club)
Hobbies: Sketching, strolling under the moonlit night

Touko has a mature air about her, yet she doesn't quite fit the mold of an adult or a child. She looks like a pretty young girl but talks in a boyish manner, setting her a bit apart from others. However, she doesn't seem to mind how she's perceived and confidently maintains her own rhythm in life.

Currently, she's dealing with an odd sense of unease about her current 'existence.' This feeling leads her to seek out a detective named Reiji, enlisting his help in a personal quest to uncover her 'true self.'

Touko carries a mysterious vibe, but she's also impulsive. For example, she might suddenly get curious about how a detective would react if they were followed, and without much thought, she'd actually try it out.
"I want you to look for something. Me. My true self."
Translated and edited from the official site
職業：櫻羽女学院生（美術部所属）
趣味：写生、月夜の散歩
外見は美少女、口調は少年、大人びた雰囲気――、
しかし、そのどれにも属さないようなミステリアスな少女。
冬子自身も「現在の自分」に言い知れない違和感を持っており、
玲人に「本当の自分を探して欲しい」と依頼してくる。
突拍子もなく思いついたことを、本当に実行してしまうような一面もある。
有成人气质，既不是成人也不是少女的生物。
喜爱绘画、月下散步。
身材颀长，肤色白皙，拥有如瀑般的披肩黑发，说话带男性的口吻，略微轻佻，却不令人生厌。从周围看来稍稍有些轻佻，但本人对周围的反应毫不在意，丝毫不影响自己的步调。
对于现在的‘名为自己的存在’感到说不出的违和感，委托时坂「寻找真正的自己」。
散发着神秘的气质，突发奇想「跟踪侦探的话他会做何反应呢」便会真的去实行。
Occupation: Student at Ouba Girls Academy (a member of the art club)
Hobbies: Drawing picture books

Kuchiki Touko’s best friend. They spend a lot of time together. She has a severe inferiority complex due to being a poor girl in a school of wealthy, well-to-do young ladies. As a result, she hates herself, her mother, and everyone else around her. Mizuhara practically worships Kuchiki Touko because she’s the only girl that ignores her background. She holds a grudge against Reiji because he gets close to her friend.
”Stay away from Touko, please.”
From MangaGamer
職業：櫻羽女学院生（美術部所属）
趣味：絵本を描く
冬子の親友で、大抵一緒に行動している。
お嬢様の多い学院で、あまり裕福でない出自に強い劣等感を抱いている彼女は、
周囲の学生、母、自分すらも嫌悪している様子。
そんな中、透子の背景を全く気にせず、友として接してくれる冬子に、
親友を通りこして「崇拝」に近い感情を抱いている。
そのため、急速に冬子と親しくなっていく玲人を、快く思っていない。
cv 吉田美海
冬子的挚友，经常在一起行动。
在多是名门千金的樱羽女学院中，即使是恭维也说不上是富裕出身的透子怀有强烈的劣等感，因此对周围的同学、母亲、甚至自己都怀有厌恶感。
但是，冬子非但不在意这些，还把自己当作挚友，对透子来说冬子正是自己的理想，对她怀有近于崇拜的感情。
对突然出现就很快与冬子变亲近的时坂感到不快，尽可能想让两人关系疏远。
Occupation: Owner of Cafe Moon World
Hobbies: Making snacks

A widow who owns Cafe Moon World. An old friend of Reiji’s and one of the few people who knows his past. Used to be best friends with Reiji’s deceased fiance, Yukiko. Since they’ve lost someone important, they can connect on a different level. Her cafe has a lot of regulars, including Detective Uozumi and Kuchiki Touko as well.
”Hold on a moment. Let me brew you up some of Kyouko’s special blend.”
Edited from MangaGamer

Kyouko had an adult relationship with Reiji for a time. Two people who had lost someone significant believed they could heal each other's wounds. However, their paths eventually diverged, never to overlap again. She struggles with the realization that Reiji's feelings are no longer with her. But then, something happens...
職業：喫茶店「月世界」オーナー
趣味：お菓子作り
喫茶店「月世界」のオーナーで未亡人。
玲人とっては昔馴染みで、互いの過去を知りあう数少ない友人同士。
玲人の亡くなった恋人・由記子とも親友同士で、
お互いに大切な者を亡くした同士、良き相談相手になっている。
店は常連客も多く、刑事の魚住や冬子など学生も良く訪れているようだ。
离吉祥寺车站很近的咖啡店「月世界」的老板娘。寡妇，从亡夫那里接手了这个店。
和时坂是老相识了，是互相了解对方过去伤痛的为数不多的朋友。称之为孽缘也可以。对时坂抱着单相思，但是知道他心有所属，在为此苦恼。
两人同样失去了最重要的人，彼此间都是很好的倾诉对象。和已逝的时坂的恋人由记子是挚友。
店里很多常客，警察鱼住夹三、冬子等学生也常来。生意十分兴隆。
最近准备让熟人的女儿作为工作人员而住下。
“男人这种生物，对年轻女孩总是黏糊糊的。”
Occupation: Student at Ouba Girls Academy, aspiring writer
Hobbies: Writing and publishing

Possesses a bright, hyperactive personality. She can be rather noisy at times. Personality-wise, the opposite of Yukari, but the two are best friends for some reason. She’s already been published in literary magazines, but she keeps her activities a secret from the academy. Reiji calls her ”Tojiko” because he thinks ”Tsuzuriko” is too hard to pronounce. She seems to admire the student body president, Tsukishima Orihime.
”I specialize in mystery novels. ...And who the heck are you calling Tojiko!?”
From MangaGamer
職業：櫻羽女学院生、学生小説家
趣味：同人誌作り
非常に明るく活発、極端に言えば煩いくらいの女の子。
紫とは正反対の性格だが、何故が馬があう親友同士。
すでに文芸誌でデビューしている現役学生作家だが、活動は学院側には秘密。
「綴子（ツヅリコ）は呼びづらい」と言う理由から、
玲人に、“トジ子”というあだ名をつけられてしまう。
上級生の月島織姫に心酔している模様。
「ん一っと、結構色々。分野としては怪奇小説だよ。……って、トジ子って誰っ!?」
cv 日向葵
十分开朗活泼。说得过分一点就是吵吵闹闹的性格，与紫正好相反。但相反也有与她合得来的挚友。
刚出道并为文艺志撰稿的现役学生作家。当然是对学院保密而悄悄活动的，也有向所谓的劣等杂志寄稿。
被时坂说「缀子（ツヅリコ）这名字太难念了」而被其擅自起了「トジ子」这个绰号。
此外，兴奋的时候就会变得很滔滔不绝，这点也是受祖母的影响，本人出生成长都在东京。
似乎很憧憬高年级学生月岛织姫。
Occupation: Detective
Hobbies: Fishing

A detective with a towering frame. Adept at the physical aspects of the occupation, including footwork. Met Reiji when they were both students; they joined the force and worked under the same supervisor. Still relies on Reiji for help with some cases. Though they tend to joke around with each other, his brawny strength is a good compliment to Reiji's critical thinking skills.
"That's a hell of a way to greet your friend when he's going out of his way to get you what you requested."
From MangaGamer

A longtime friend of Reiji and Kyouko since their school days, Uozumi was unexpectedly promoted and transferred to a regional position following the case related to "The Girl in the Shell." This move led to an unwanted separation from Kyoko, whom he has feelings for. He was mainly concerned for Kyouko after she suffered severe injuries in the incident. This circumstance solidified Uozumi's determination to be the one to protect her.
職業：刑事
趣味：釣り
大柄で強面な、現職の刑事。
見た目通りの肉体派で、足を使った捜査と荒事を担当。
玲人とは学生時代からの付き合いで、同じ上司についていた元同僚。
現在でも、捜査協力を依頼するなど、腐れ縁は切れていないようだ。
互いに軽口を叩き合っているが、頭脳派と肉体派で相性はいい。
現職の刑事で時坂や秋五とは同じ上司の下で働いていた｡大柄かつ強面なため下手な犯罪者よりよほど迫力がある｡
見た目通りの肉体派｡頭脳労働は苦手と割り切り､自らは足を使った捜査と荒事担当として先陣を走る｡
時坂とは学生時代からの付き合いがあり､現在も捜査協力を依頼するなど腐れ縁は切れていない｡
互いに軽口を叩き合ってはいるが頭脳派と肉体派で相性はいいようだ｡
｢ご挨拶だな､ﾃﾒｪに頼まれたﾌﾞﾂを持ってきたんだろうが｣
Occupation: Waitress at Cafe Moon World
Hobbies: Cooking (still in training)

A girl who works at Cafe Moon World. Gives her all to everything she does. Used to help out at the brothel Yukishiro, but after the establishment was shut down, Madam Ujaku took Hatsune under her wing and gave her the name Amemiya. She learned how to write from Shuugo when they both lived at the Yukishiro, so she gets mad if you say anything bad about him.
”Umm, you can just call me Hatsune. I’m not really used to it yet...”
From MangaGamer
職業：喫茶店「月世界」ウェイトレス
趣味：料理（勉強中）
『カルタグラ～ツキ狂イノ病～』に登場したヒロイン。
現在は「月世界」で働く、何事にも一生懸命な女の子。
以前は娼館「雪白」で手伝いをしていたが、様々な事情から娼館は解体、
その後、女将であった雨雀に引き取られ、“雨宮”を名乗る。
「雪白」時代に世話をしていた秋五から、文字などを教わっていたことから、
秋五の悪口を言われると、ムキになる。
在秋五租住的妓院『雪白』打杂的少女。因为某个原因失去了亲人，从小时候开始一直住在雪白。
由于长久以来和成年人混在一起工作，尽管容貌如梦如幻，性格倒是很可靠。但在另一方面，有着压抑自己感情的倾向。
很是黏着秋五，主动为其打理早晚伙食和贴身琐事。
A private detective based in Ueno. Used to work with Reiji and Uozumi and still helps out his friends when needed.

Married to Kazuna, a former client with whom he shares a lot of history. Since she's currently pregnant, Shugo focuses on less dangerous tasks like investigating cheating spouses and searching for people in order to worry her less.
From MangaGamer
He is the younger brother of Natsume, and older brother of Nana.
職業：私立探偵
趣味：なし
『カルタグラ～ツキ狂イノ病～』の主人公。
玲人、魚住とは元同僚同士で、必要であれば今でも協力しあう間柄。
現在は、過去の出来事を振り切り和菜と結婚。
身重のため、実家に帰っている和菜を心配させないように、
浮気調査や人探しの依頼を中心に、物騒な依頼は受けないようにしている。
「大切なもの、オレは守り切れるだろうか」
本作の主人公。遊郭『雪白』に間借りして日々を過ごす成年。
元警察官という経歴を持ち、探偵業の真似事をして食い扶持を得ている。
かつての上司・有島警部より彼に人探しの依頼が持ち込まれた時、本作の物語は幕を開ける。
在上野当侦探。‘カルタグラ’（恋狱）的主人公。
在过去的事件之后与和菜结婚。现在由于和菜因身孕回娘家修养而处于独自工作的状态。
为了不让心爱的妻子担心，主要接受调查外遇、寻人之类的委托，拒绝了一些比较危险的委托。
和本作的主人公·时坂以及鱼住在参军时代、警察时代隶属同一上司麾下，现在有必要的话也会协助他们。

Stage actress. Credited under her maiden name, "Kouzuki Kazuna". A very well known actress. Went through a lot of crazy things in her past, but ultimately ended up marrying Shuugo. Seems to be (comparatively) more calm and mature after getting married... or not. Her chest is still rather flat. Currently taking a break from acting due to pregnancy. Though she stays at home most of the time, she'll stop by Shuugo's office from time to time to see to his needs.
From MangaGamer
職業：女優（休業中）
趣味：和物
『カルタグラ～ツキ狂イノ病～』のヒロイン。
今では、結構名の売れた舞台女優である。
秋五と結婚してからは（比較的）落ち着き、歳相応に大人びた
……とも言えなくもない。が、相変わらず乳は小さい。
現在は、身重のため舞台を休業し、実家に帰っているが、
時たま、秋五の世話をしにやってきている様子。
Kouhai to Yukari and Touko. Best friends with Satou Ayumu. One of the missing students from the academy.
From MangaGamer
職業：櫻羽女学院生（美術部所属）
趣味：写生
紫や冬子の後輩。
同学年の佐東歩とは親友同士。
現在、行方不明になっている女学生の一人。
櫻羽女学院の美術部員。紫や冬子の後輩。
同学年で剣道部の佐東歩とは親友同士。
現在は行方不明で、その捜索も時坂への依頼に含まれている。
Nishizono Yui's best friend. As a result, she often runs into Yukari and the rest of the art club members. Became rather depressed after Yui disappeared, and as a result, doesn't talk to others much.
Edited from MangaGamer
Ayumu's a female student aspiring to be a detective assistant and is Yukari's junior. Her fervent sense of justice and androgynous charm have earned her popularity among her peers.

While she is determined to pursue her dream, the path to becoming a detective assistant is not straightforward, especially as it requires Reiji's consent, which she has yet to secure. Currently, she's thoughtfully contemplating her next steps to pursue her ambition.
職業：櫻羽女学院生（剣道部所属）
趣味：剣道
西園唯の親友。
その関係で、紫たち美術部の面々とも面識がある。
唯が行方不明になってから、意気消沈気味で、
他の人ともあまり関わろうとしなくなった。
希望成为侦探助手的女子学生，同时也是剑道部的王牌。
正义感很强很讲礼貌的热血少女，散发出冷酷的中性气质。
仅一年，身材和胸部就有了很明显的发育。
因此加强了中性的气质，不那麽像男孩子了。
“我也一起去，毕竟我是时坂先生的助手。”
Occupation: Student at Ouba Girls Academy, student body president
Hobbies: Reading
A talented girl that serves as Ouba Girls Academy's student council president. Comes from an extremely wealthy and influential family. Her charisma makes her an idol of many of her classmates.

Orihime was trying to disturb the social order by gathering female students in Tokyo who were suppressed just like her and forming a prostitution group and she uses contraceptives regularly. However, she's starting to regret her action as the members began to be killed one after another.
"Sensei, do you believe that Heaven and Hell exist?"
From MangaGamer and Wikipedia
職業：櫻羽女学院生、会長
趣味：読書
櫻羽女学院で会長を務める才女で、
親が大富豪の権力者という、筋金入りのお嬢様。
高いカリスマ性も持っていて、
様々な要因から、下級生の憧れの的になっている。
父母是权力者、大富豪的正牌大小姐。
才色兼备如公主一般，被低年级学生们所憧憬。
生来就拥有让对方对其俯首的手段。

Yukari and Co.'s homeroom teacher. A highly unassuming person; doesn't stand out very much. Advises Reiji that the school rules do not allow for much interaction between siblings. Appears to sympathize with Reiji as he struggles to deal with the seemingly emotionless students that lack any trace of individuality.
From MangaGamer
職業：櫻羽女学院、教師
趣味：映画鑑賞
紫や冬子たちの担任教師。
基本的には、大人しく目立たないタイプだが、
学院の規律として、玲人に「兄妹でもあまり親しげに話すのはどうか」など、
苦言を呈してくる。
とはいえ、無個性且つ無感動な学生たちに戸惑っている玲人には、同情もしているようだ。
櫻羽女学院教師。紫や冬子達の担任でもある。
学生達の様子に戸惑う時坂に同情しつつ、学院の規則として兄妹でもあまり親しげに話してはいけないと苦言も呈してくる。
基本的に目立たないおとなしい性格。

Vice principal of Ouba Girls Academy; faculty advisor to the art club. Hires Reiji to search for the missing students at his school. Pleads with him to conduct an investigation within school grounds in order to prevent any more casualties.
From MangaGamer
職業：櫻羽女学院、教頭
趣味：写生
櫻羽女学院の教頭で、美術部顧問。
玲人に、行方不明の学生の捜査を依頼した人物。
その際、これ以上の被害を防ぐため、
学院内部の調査もして欲しいと要望する。
私立櫻羽女学院で教頭を務めている。
時坂に行方不明の学生を探して欲しいと依頼しにきた人物で、その際にこれ以上の被害を防ぐ為にも学院の内側から調査して欲しいと要望した。
美術部の顧問でもある。

School nurse at Ouba Girls Academy. Ensures the students' well-being and keeps records of their physical examinations. It looks like you'll have to meet with her frequently to get information about your investigation.
From MangaGamer
職業：櫻羽女学院、養護教諭

Chizuru is Touko's adoptive mother, taking her in as a foster child during her early years. At first, Chizuru earnestly worked on building a mother-daughter bond. However, as Touko grew older and more beautiful, Chizuru noticed her brother, Fumiya, becoming attracted to Touko. This realization caused a rift to develop in their relationship. For Chizuru, her brother was her entire world, and the agony of feeling him drawn to Touko was unbearable.
